req_statements.R1: WHEN `seekandemploy apply notes <id> --set <text>` runs against an existing application id, the system shall persist `<text>` as that application's `notes` field.
req_statements.R2: WHEN `seekandemploy apply notes <id> --clear` runs against an existing application id, the system shall persist NULL as that application's `notes` field.
req_statements.R3: WHEN a notes edit succeeds, the system shall print to stdout the application line in the tracker-glance format (`[<id>] <status> <company> - <title>`) followed by the report path (`report: <path>`).
req_statements.R4: WHEN a notes edit succeeds, the system shall regenerate the static HTML snapshot from the current database contents at the path given by `--out` (default `applications.html`).
req_statements.R5: WHEN notes are edited, the system shall not append any row to `application_event`.
req_statements.R6: WHEN notes are edited, the system shall not alter the application's status, company, title, url, salary expectation, salary currency, applied date, or source job-offer link.
req_statements.R7: WHEN `apply notes` receives an id with no matching application, the system shall print `error: application <id> not found` to stderr and exit with code 1, leaving the HTML snapshot untouched.
req_statements.R8: The system shall accept `--set <text>` and `--clear` only individually, requiring exactly one per invocation, and shall answer an invocation with both flags or with neither as a usage error with exit code 2.
